archetype: Archetype 2 (The Performance Pro) mixed with Archetype 7 (Electric & Neon)
vibe: Cinematic, Video-Game Main Menu (EA Sports FC / FIFA style), High-end Premium Futsal SaaS

scales.h1: text-6xl md:text-8xl font-black uppercase tracking-tighter italic
scales.label: text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-[0.2em] text-[#00E5FF]

visual_enhancers.layering: Use 'bg-black/60' vignettes over stadium backgrounds to allow vibrant UI layers to pop. Utilize skewed shapes (transform: skewX(-5deg)) for speed lines and dynamic presentation.
visual_enhancers.animations: Framer Motion for page transitions. Scale up cards on hover (scale-105) with border glow. Staggered fade-ins for leaderboard rows and brackets.

cinematic_hero.layout: Fullscreen (100vh), flex-col, justify-end pb-24 px-8 md:px-16
cinematic_hero.background: Dark stadium image with a heavy linear-gradient overlay (to-b from-black/20 via-black/60 to-[#030305])
cinematic_hero.content: Massive italicized H1 'ARENA PREMIUM', neon blue CTA button skewed slightly, overlaying glowing particles.

main_menu_cards.style: EA FC style tall rectangular cards (w-64 h-96). Glassmorphic background, subtle inner shadow.
main_menu_cards.hover_state: Scale up to 1.05, border color shifts to #00E5FF, electric blue box-shadow, inner image saturation increases.

booking_calendar_slot.base: Flex row, items-center, justify-between, p-4, backdrop-blur-md bg-white/5 border-l-4 rounded-r-lg cursor-pointer
booking_calendar_slot.typography: Time in Rajdhani bold, price in Exo 2 right-aligned.

matchmaking_modal.layout: Grid cols-3, items-center. Left: User Team Crest, Right: Opponent Crest, Center: 'VS' text glowing.
matchmaking_modal.action: PIX payment button, full width, electric blue background, black text.

tournament_bracket_node.style: Rectangular dark card, 2 rows (Team A, Team B). Winning team has white text, losing team has gray text.

leaderboard_row.style: Grid layout. Dense control room grid. Rank, Crest, Team Name, Points.
leaderboard_row.top_3: Rank number glows. 1st place gold (#FFB800), 2nd silver, 3rd bronze.

admin_kpi_card.style: Cardless or very subtle 1px border. Dark gray surface. Big numbers in Rajdhani. Small trend indicator in green/red.

instructions_to_main_agent: Install and use 'lucide-react' for icons. Phosphor icons are also acceptable.
Install Google Fonts: Teko (or Rajdhani) for headings, Exo 2 for body. Import them in index.css.
Do NOT use standard Shadcn cards for the main menu. Create custom Framer Motion enabled tall rectangular cards.
Use Radix UI / Shadcn for the Matchmaking Dialog/Modal, but heavily override the styles to match the dark glassmorphism theme.
Implement 'data-testid' on all booking slots, buttons, and form elements.
Do not use generic 'Inter' anywhere. The vibe relies entirely on the typography conveying speed and sport.
For the PIX mock payment, build a simple modal that shows a mock QR code and a 'Simulate Payment' button that transitions state from Pending to Confirmed.
For tournaments, use CSS Grid for the bracket layout with custom SVG lines connecting the nodes if possible, or simple border hacks.
Apply backdrop-blur heavily. Text over images must have enough contrast; use text-shadow if necessary.
